doc: The range-of-motion suite's poses (tool/rom, 2026-10-01): named, deterministic presets in anatomical terms, applied by charkit.pose to any humanoid skeleton (see its docstring for the ops). Grouped by what they stress; the hands after the hand sheet's poses (refs gen/hand_breakdown.png: relaxed, open, fist, point). Report-only: there is no drawing of these poses; physical limits are the thresholds (charkit.rom).

arms_up.what: both arms overhead, the clavicles raised 25 deg

arms_forward.what: both arms reaching forward at shoulder height, the clavicles forward 10 deg

arm_across.what: the left arm across the chest: the upper arm forward and in at chest height, the elbow bent 100 deg, the forearm across the chest toward the right shoulder

raise_side_90.what: both arms raised 90 deg to the side (T-pose)

raise_forward_90.what: both arms raised 90 deg forward, horizontal

arm_twist_90.what: both upper arms turned 90 deg inward about their axis, the elbows straight (the shoulder's candy-wrapper test)

elbows_90.what: both elbows bent 90 deg, the upper arms hanging

elbows_135.what: both elbows bent 135 deg, the upper arms hanging

wrist_twist_90.what: the elbows bent 90 deg and the hands turned 90 deg inward about the forearm (the wrist's candy-wrapper test: the rig has no forearm twist bone)

wrists_bent.what: the elbows bent 90 deg and the wrists flexed 60 deg toward the palm

knees_90.what: both knees bent 90 deg, the thighs hanging

knees_135.what: both knees bent 135 deg, the thighs hanging

squat.what: a deep squat: the pelvis tipped 15 deg forward, the hips flexed 105 deg (thighs horizontal), the knees 125 deg, the ankles taking the shins' lean, the spine 20 deg forward

kick_front.what: the left leg kicked forward to 95 deg (above horizontal), the knee nearly straight, the torso leaning back 10 deg

kick_side.what: the left leg kicked out to the side, 70 deg from hanging

spine_twist.what: the torso turned 45 deg to her left (15 each at the spine, chest and upper chest), the head following

spine_side.what: the torso bent 30 deg to her left (10 each)

head_turn.what: the head turned 60 deg to her left (neck 25, head 35)

head_turn_right.what: the head turned 60 deg to her right

head_up.what: the head tipped back 35 deg (looking up)

head_tilt.what: the head tilted 25 deg toward her left shoulder (neck 10, head 15)

hand_fist.what: both hands in a fist (the hand sheet's fist): the knuckles 85, the middle joints 100, the tips 60; the thumb folded across

hand_open.what: both hands open and spread (the hand sheet's open hand): the fingers fanned 12-25 deg apart, the thumb out 35

hand_point.what: both hands pointing (the hand sheet's point): the index straight, the other fingers curled, the thumb over them
